scope: Precomputed-feature reference benchmark; not production acceptance
target: class_label: anomalous=1, normal=0; quality_label not used
features: Original_Features columns excluding number and all *_opt columns; optimized feature fitting provenance is unverified
calibration: Publisher training variants whose SHA256 with lenze-v1 salt modulo 5 equals 0; other training variants fit model
cutoff: 95th percentile higher of negative score_samples on normal calibration records; alert strictly above cutoff
test: Publisher test partition; no cutoff or candidate selection on test outcomes
limitations: Precomputed feature extraction provenance and weak labels limit acceptance scope; preserve all test rows
